intro: The Wrath of Rath'mael is a Forsaken quest issued by Deathguard Kristof in Brill. Adventurers are tasked with entering the fog-shrouded Ruins of Lordaeron to eliminate Rath'mael, a Scourge necromancer concealing undead movements above the Undercity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.
Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, friend.
If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.
